candidate_workaround: Search the containing directory with ripgrep's explicit glob filter or pass explicit file paths.
failure_signature: A wildcard embedded in a Windows path was treated as a literal invalid path by ripgrep.
recurrence_guard: On Windows, pass a real directory to ripgrep and use -g for filename selection rather than embedding a wildcard in the path argument.
rollback: Give the failed diagnostic zero evidence credit and do not infer absence from an invalid-path search.
scope_boundary: Same-owner diagnostic portability recovery only; not a filesystem, privacy, or search-completeness guarantee.
title: Keep ripgrep globs out of Windows path arguments
trigger_preconditions: the intended search targets a filename family
